logp.method_description: The hydrophobicity of Re-Phen was determined from the partitioning of Re-Phen in a mixture of 1-octanol and phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) buffer (pH 7.4) at room temperature. Re-Phen (1 mg) in PBS buffer (1 mL) was added to 1 mL of 1-octanol saturated with PBS buffer. The mixture was shaken for 1 h, and the phases were separated after being left overnight at room temperature. The concentrations of Re-Phen in the organic and the aqueous phases were determined by HPLC. The partitioning coefficient (logP) was calculated as the logarithm of the ratio of the concentrations of Re-Phen in 1-octanol and PBS buffer.
